metadata.title: SpeLL: An Agent for Natural Language-Driven Intelligent Spectral Modeling
metadata.authors: Jiashun Fu; Xuyang Liu; Wensheng Cai; Haohao Fu; Xueguang Shao
metadata.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

selected_evidence.text: SpeLL uses LLM and retrieval-augmented generation for NIR spectral data modeling. It has Code RAG for specialized spectral-analysis code and Data RAG for historical spectral datasets, with natural-language interaction, code generation/execution, and Auto-Debug. Core RAG/spectroscopy source. The project uses NIR, so distinguish its modality and task from SPEKTRA visible measurements.
